F1_c2_collision_filter.what: drop every row whose passage or claim collides with any evaluation surface under any string form / pairing clause C2 tests

F2_c1_length_filter.what: drop every row whose claim exceeds the chosen Unicode content-token cap - the measured cause of the lost resolution (the 25+ token band reads delta 0.0010, AUROC 0.4094 on the original member)
F2_c1_length_filter.axis: Unicode \w+ content tokens of the claim, campaign stopwords removed
F2_c1_length_filter.cap_selection_rule: largest cap whose pooled delta clears the 0.1 band by >= 0.01 on BOTH containment instruments

conforming_pipeline.what_was_NOT_done: no label changed, no leg re-weighted, no clause threshold moved, no instrument re-tuned. The pipeline removes rows and nothing else

C1.head_declared: grounding scalar (`task_head`) - the served ground() score
C1.label_predicate_measured: label 1 iff the corpus's `labels` span list is EMPTY, i.e. the annotator marked no hallucinated span in the LLM answer given the retrieved Wikipedia passage; label 0 iff at least one span of the answer was marked unsupported. The predicate is span-level SUPPORT of the answer by the passage, not question relevance - the same predicate the grounding head consumes
C1.label_provenance: GPT-4o end-to-end span annotation, no human verification (dataset card)

instruments.primary: R20_gates_pubmedqa.containment over R20_gates_pubmedqa.content (ASCII [a-z0-9]+ content tokens, campaign stopwords)
instruments.companion_flagged_separately: same containment over Unicode \w+ tokens - the banked tokenizer scores no non-Latin script, so it is reported beside the primary, not instead of it

coverage.note: a row is unscorable when the claim has no content token under that tokenizer; unscorable rows are excluded from the distributions below

containment_banked_ascii.bar: REJECTED for the grounding head if |rate(>=0.90 attested)_neg - rate(>=0.90 attested)_pos| <= 0.10

containment_unicode.bar: REJECTED for the grounding head if |rate(>=0.90 attested)_neg - rate(>=0.90 attested)_pos| <= 0.10

executor_added_diagnostics.note: reported separately from the C1 test; these do not join the clause verdict
executor_added_diagnostics.annotated_span_reading: containment of the marked-hallucinated fragments themselves against the passage; low values corroborate that the corpus label tracks support rather than relevance

C1.verdict_basis: reading A of the clause bar (the reading that rejects R20-H175b's lane), taken on the Unicode instrument - the only one that scores all 14 languages. The banked ASCII instrument is reported beside it and agrees here; on the unconformed member the two straddled the band
C1.measured: rate(containment >= 0.90) negative 0.0326 vs positive 0.1428, delta 0.1102 against a <= 0.10 rejection band, OUTSIDE it by 0.0102 (banked ASCII: neg 0.0351 vs pos 0.1646, delta 0.1295, outside by 0.0295)

C2.directions: both - member-in-surface and surface-in-member counted per form

C3.split_axis_measured: QUESTION, not document: 94.4% of held-out passages are byte-identical to a train passage while 11.7% of held-out questions recur in train
C3.implication_for_any_eval_built_from_this: an eval drawn from the official validation/test split inherits 94.4% of its passages from the training member, so it cannot satisfy C2 by split membership; membership of the assembled mix must be measured passage by passage

C5.why: C5 binds every CONSTRUCTED lane and every paired-contrast eval. This member is a source corpus loaded verbatim from the archive and then row-filtered; the conforming pipeline removes rows and creates no construction, no pair structure, no neg_family and no within-pair channel, so the registered probes (claim-only converged, within-pair claim-only, single-channel, surface parity, attestation symmetry) still have no object to compute over. No proxy is substituted.
C5.checked_after_conforming: the filters are row removals keyed on claim length and on evaluation-surface collision; neither introduces a constructed contrast

R20-H175b_qlane_eval.parquet.feature: max content-token containment of the eval claim in whatever answer the member associates with the pair's key

R20-H175b_qlane_eval_repaired.parquet.feature: max content-token containment of the eval claim in whatever answer the member associates with the pair's key

R20-H175b_qlane_eval_clean.parquet.feature: max content-token containment of the eval claim in whatever answer the member associates with the pair's key

R20-H175b_qlane_eval_clean_prefix.parque.feature: max content-token containment of the eval claim in whatever answer the member associates with the pair's key

C6.note: the member is not pair-structured, so the within-member reading is the key-repeat channel; the cross-surface reading reproduces the R20-H175b feature against this member's own associations
C6.measured: best leave-one-out key-majority predictor beats the majority-class baseline by -0.0096

C7.declared_unit: rows - the member is a source corpus with no contrast pairing; each row is one (claim, evidence, label) triple
C7.pairs_definition: one (claim, evidence) pair per row; the corpus carries no positive/negative contrast pairing, so pairs == rows
C7.registration_basis: the conformed member is a NEW artifact and is registered at the volume it builds to; the 61,712-row registration belongs to the unconformed member and is carried below as the volume cost, not as this member's target
C7.measured: 50474 rows / 50474 pairs, unit declared ROWS, registration margin 0; volume cost of conforming 11238 rows (18.2%)

C8.selection_predicate: dataset-psiloqa.zip -> s-nlp__PsiloQA__train.parquet ONLY; base filter wiki_passage.len_chars > 50 AND llm_answer.len_chars > 10; label = (labels.list.len() == 0); claim = llm_answer; chunk = wiki_passage UNTRUNCATED (then windowed 1500/750 under H150/H174); THEN the two conforming filters: F1 drop every row whose passage or claim collides with any evaluation surface in any string form or pairing clause C2 tests; F2 drop every row whose claim exceeds 42 Unicode content tokens
C8.public_repo_check: artifact carries corpus identifiers and repository-relative paths only; no client or company name
C8.note: every C8 requirement is stated here and measured from the archive, but the retrieval date is NOT recorded in the tracked sidecar data/external/datasets/dataset-psiloqa.md - it is taken from the archive's filesystem mtime, which is weaker evidence than a recorded fetch date. Carried forward unchanged from the unconformed member's verification; the conforming pipeline does not touch it

C4.instrument: provenance_gate.py, R14-H136 ruling-2 form: 8-gram, Jaccard >= 0.3, bidirectional, KILL > 2%; thresholds read from R19_supply_gates.py

live_positive_control.construction: PsiloQA validation+test passages against the member's own train passages - near-duplicate by construction (C3), so a gate that cannot fire is caught

executor_added_diagnostics.note: reported SEPARATELY from every clause test; none of these joins a clause verdict

C1_margin_in_standard_errors.instrument: Unicode full-coverage containment, the instrument the C1 verdict is taken on
C1_margin_in_standard_errors.reading: how firmly the conformed member sits outside the rejection band; the unconformed member sat INSIDE it by 0.0069

summary.headline: the conformed member is 50,474 rows, 11,238 fewer than the 61,712 it was built from (18.2% of the member), and passes every clause: C1 clears the rejection band by 0.0102 on the full-coverage instrument and by 0.0295 on the banked one - both readings agree where the unconformed member's straddled - and C2 reads zero against all nine evaluation surfaces in every string form and direction

what_the_pipeline_did.F1: removed 1379 rows (485 distinct passages) that collided with an evaluation surface - all of them with the two withdrawn PsiloQA-derived H175b evals, none with a live surface, which already read zero
what_the_pipeline_did.F2: removed a further 9859 rows whose claim exceeds 42 Unicode content tokens - the band the original measurement showed carries no containment resolution
what_the_pipeline_did.not_done: no label changed, no leg re-weighted, no threshold moved, no instrument re-tuned

volume_cost.share_of_mix: 7.48% of the 674,432-row mix, down from 9.00% of 685,670

residual_findings_the_pipeline_does_NOT_.C1_margin_is_thin: the pooled delta clears the 0.10 band by 0.0102, which is 2.14 binomial standard errors of the delta. The selection rule was fixed before the sweep was read (largest cap clearing by >= 0.01 on both instruments); the whole sweep is in the artifact, and every smaller cap clears by more at more volume cost
residual_findings_the_pipeline_does_NOT_.low_resolution_supervision_is_reduced_no: 10,993 conformed rows still sit in the 25+ content-token band, where containment reads AUROC 0.434 against the label. Languages at or below chance fall from 7 of 14 to 3 of 14 (eu, fi, zh)
residual_findings_the_pipeline_does_NOT_.C3_is_a_corpus_property_and_survives: the corpus still cuts per question: 94.4% of its held-out passages are byte-identical to a train passage, and 4,765 of 5,687 still sit in the mix through this member (5,311 before). No pipeline over the train split can change that; any eval built from this corpus's official validation/test split remains foreclosed
residual_findings_the_pipeline_does_NOT_.C8_retrieval_date: recorded from the archive mtime, not from the tracked sidecar, exactly as for the unconformed member
